rules.statement: A valid fidei commissum is created where the language of a document clearly indicates an intention that property shall remain in the family for the benefit of the members of the family and shall not be alienated outside the family.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now the words 'I do ordain that the said four donees during their life time shall not mortgage, sell, or transfer to any outsider except among themselves the said donated lands' do not create a fidei commissum in favour of the members of a family."
